donor.title: effects: preserve UNKNOWN outcome after EntityOS runtime exceptions

checkpoint_discriminator: Falsify post-process-start outcome classification: timeout and non-timeout exceptions after successful child start must not be upgraded to definite non-application without authority-owned verification.

bridge_semantics: A successful subprocess.Popen return is treated as the observed child-start boundary.
Exceptions from proc.communicate after that boundary are converted to EntityOSOutcomeUnknown.
A successful communicate with unresolved returncode=None is also converted to EntityOSOutcomeUnknown.
Best-effort kill/wait cleanup is explicitly non-retroactive: it cannot prove that an external effect did not already occur.
source_observation.non_timeout_case: StartedProcess.communicate raises OSError('result channel lost') after Popen returned; expected EntityOSOutcomeUnknown with replay_permitted=false plus best-effort kill/wait.
source_observation.review_conclusion: The CURRENT F2 checkpoint's source-level timeout/non-timeout post-start discriminator is satisfied by the retained PR430 donor source/test patch at the observed head. This does not mean the donor is adopted into F2, merged, or runtime-accepted.

hypothesis: Once a child has crossed the Popen-return boundary, a missing or exceptional result path cannot establish non-application; UNKNOWN is the fail-closed classification until authority-owned verification resolves it.
counterhypothesis: Some post-Popen exceptions could be proven pre-effect by a stronger authority-owned execution protocol with an explicit commit/apply acknowledgment boundary; PR430 does not currently provide such proof, so treating those exceptions as definitely FAILED would be unsound.
next_exact_action: The WP105 mutation-authority owner may consume/adapt the retained PR430 UNKNOWN-outcome semantics into the single canonical F2 effect path if still needed after source comparison. Before any runtime credit, execute the exact adopted/pinned source on an admitted surface whose job actually enters test steps; keep UNKNOWN fail-closed and forbid blind replay. Recheck the existing blocked transport rather than stampeding duplicate runs.
